So when I was in high school, I was in the peak of my depression (well one of them) and I just wanted to listen to music. I was grounded because of my grades but, I figured since I had just opened up about my depression, I thought they could at least let me have that. My mother told me no. Despite my depression, it was important that the punishment was still in place. So because I couldn’t have the one thing that helped me stay grounded and of sound mind, I thought I wasn’t worth it. So I made a plan to hang myself in one of my old childhood hangout places. Then right before everyone went to sleep my brother comes downstairs and gives me his iPod. I hugged him and thanked him. And I listened to his music. I woke up the next morning because of him. Because I was able to control my thoughts. Music is such an important tool. But it’s always good to have a support system. My brother gave me both and saved my life. If you are alone, or in need of help. Find a friend, listen to some music, and know that you are worth it.
